name.title: Name
name.description: Native job name used to identify this monitor and its history. Renaming creates a separate monitor.

site_id.title: Site ID
site_id.description: Groups this job with other DEM jobs for the same site; leave empty to keep it unassigned. Use 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

script.title: Script
script.description: Inline Playwright Test JavaScript or TypeScript source. Leave empty when using Script path.

script_path.title: Script path
script_path.description: Absolute path to a readable Playwright Test JavaScript or TypeScript entry file. Leave empty when using Script.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials passed to the workflow as named environment variables. Leave empty for workflows without credentials.

name.title: Environment name
name.description: Unique environment variable name starting with DEM_SECRET_, followed by letters, digits or underscores.

value.title: Value
value.description: Credential value or a native secret reference, such as ${env:WORKFLOW_PASSWORD}.

screenshot_on_failure.title: Capture failure screenshot
screenshot_on_failure.description: Save a screenshot when a workflow check fails. Screenshots can contain sensitive page content; timeout capture is best effort.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Browser attempt timeout, in seconds. Waiting for another browser attempt is excluded.

site_id.ui:help: The ID does not replace the job name or require a RUM job. Retained runs and captures keep the association recorded when they were produced.
